header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Mir Pervez Akhter Talpur advocate for the respondent No.8.
None present on behalf of the petitioners nor any intimation is received.
This petition was filed in the year 2023 and lastly fixed in Court on
18.11.2024. Thereafter, no efforts have been made by the counsel for the
body: petitioners to get fix the matter in Court and to proceed with the matter. It appears that counsel for the petitioners has lost interest in the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution. JUDGE JUDGE *Chander Kumar*
